non_vacuity_by_mutation.principle: Non-vacuity must be proved by MUTATION targeting the FEATURE UNDER TEST, not merely its oracle.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.author_campaign: 80/80 mutations failed on both compilers: 46 oracle, 13 setup-input, 7 reorder/same-multiset, 7 drop, 7 duplicate.
reviewer_reran: REORDER: [three,empty,one], [alloc,ptr], and a reversed character constructor all FAILED as required
DROP: [empty,three] FAILED (size=3; LFortran additionally caught the out-of-bounds statically)
DUPLICATE: [one,empty,three,one] and a character duplicate both FAILED
EMPTY MUTATED to empty(1)=67 FAILED (size=5), which is what proves the empty array genuinely contributes nothing
non_vacuity_by_mutation.reviewer_verdict: The reorder/drop/duplicate classes are SUFFICIENT for array-constructor sequence and extent fixtures, because they are exactly the mutations an oracle checking only the multiset of values would survive.
non_vacuity_by_mutation.reverse_mutation: one(1)=62 with the oracle updated to 62 PASSED, proving the sentinel is load-bearing.

oracle_discipline_verified.no_self_referential_intrinsic: No RESHAPE, PACK, SPREAD, MERGE, TRANSFER or address-based oracle appears. Elements are read back BY SUBSCRIPT against hand-computed literals.
oracle_discipline_verified.sentinels: Integer sentinels are distinct and nonzero (61,73,79,83 and 41,43,47,53), so a zero-filled or defaulted result is rejected.
oracle_discipline_verified.character_discipline: LEN is asserted before every character value check, guarding the blank-padding trap.
oracle_discipline_verified.kind_safety: KIND==k uses k=kind(0), so no non-default kind is assumed to exist.

integrator_corrective_action.issue: Binding 7 facets into array_constructors.json staled FIVE PRE-EXISTING 7.8 fixture reviews. Unlike the Clause 10 packets in this checkpoint, 7.8 ALREADY HAD fixtures bound to it, so the content-bound staleness propagated to them as well as to the catalogue review.
integrator_corrective_action.why_it_matters: This is a broader form of the batch121 lesson. It is not enough to renew the catalogue review: binding into a catalogue that ALREADY HAS FIXTURES also stales those fixtures' own reviews.
integrator_corrective_action.near_miss: Four of the five could not be renewed as reference-validated and errored with 'no successful reference at the required phase and supported mode'. Investigation showed they were originally SOURCE-REVIEWED, not reference-validated, and do not pass under gfortran in that mode. Renewing them as reference-validated would have recorded a FALSE reference validation. They were renewed at their ORIGINAL state instead, and source-reviewed correctly returned to 274.
integrator_corrective_action.rule_added: A fixture packet must renew (a) the catalogue source review for every catalogue it binds into, AND (b) every pre-existing fixture review in those catalogues - each at its OWN original review state, never upgraded.
